query:
INSERT INTO collection_sources (
                collection_id,
                provider,
                source_kind,
                source_key,
                source_scope_key,
                title,
                refreshed_at,
                updated_at
            ) VALUES ($1, 'tmdb', $2::varchar, $3, 'global', $4, NOW(), NOW())
            ON CONFLICT (provider, source_kind, source_key, source_scope_key)
            DO UPDATE SET
                collection_id = EXCLUDED.collection_id,
                title = EXCLUDED.title,
                refreshed_at = NOW(),
                updated_at = NOW()
            RETURNING id
